why: Response 1 names a sharper crux (whether full-time hours actually drive growth) and gives dated next steps with stop rules. It also avoids presenting guessed expenses as fact, although its council scaffolding makes it harder to read. Response 2 is clearer and its runway math checks out, but it rests on an assumed $3,000 monthly burn, and its $2,500 MRR trigger is below that assumed spending.
